title: Call Centre Agent
description:
Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Doncaster team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Doncaster contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Sharp Consultancy are delighted to be working with a successful and established business in Doncaster who are looking to recruit a Credit Controller to join their finance team on a full-time, permanent basis.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller to join a supportive working environment where creating strong relationships, taking ownership and delivering results are valued.

The role:

Working as part of a collaborative finance team, you will take responsibility for the day-to-day credit control function, helping to maintain strong customer relationships whilst ensuring outstanding payments are collected efficiently and professionally.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing the sales ledger and monitoring outstanding customer accounts.
- Proactively chasing overdue payments via telephone and email.
- Building positive customer relationships to resolve invoice queries and payment issues.
- Allocating cash and reconciling customer accounts.
- Monitoring aged debt and identifying potential risks.
- Working closely with colleagues across finance and other departments to support cash flow and achieve shared objectives.

What we're looking for:
- Previous experience in a credit control or accounts receivable role.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- A proactive, determined approach to collecting outstanding debt.
- Excellent organisational skills and a keen eye for detail.
- The ability to manage your own workload whilst working effectively as part of a team.
- A professional and honest approach when dealing with customers and colleagues.

What's on offer?
- A salary of up to £29,000.
- Full-time, permanent employment.
- Hybrid working for a better work-life balance.
- The opportunity to join a supportive finance team.
- A varied role where your contribution can make a genuine difference.

For more information, please apply or reach out to Tom Davage at Sharp Consultancy.

Sharp Consultancy is a finance and accountancy recruitment specialist assisting accounting and finance divisions of businesses in the Yorkshire and Derbyshire area. With over 30 years' experience we pride ourselves on sourcing excellent finance professionals across all divisions of an accounts function.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK full time without restriction. To apply please send your CV to the e-mail address stated, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, we receive it is not always possible to respond to unsuccessful applicants. Therefore, if we have not responded to your application within seven days, please note that on this occasion your application has not been successful.

title: HR & Operations Coordinator
description:
Are you an experienced Administrator, Office Coordinator or Business Support Coordinator with strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail?

Do you have strong Excel skills, and the ability to manage multiple administrative processes independently?

Are you looking for a varied, stable coordination role within a supportive team, where you can take ownership of your workload without needing a background in HR?

Location: Doncaster, South Yorkshire - Potential for up to 2 days hybrid working per week
Salary: Up to £33,000 per annum DOE
Working Hours: 39 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with flexible start times between 8:00am and 8:30am
Benefits:
25 days annual leave
Pension scheme - minimum 5% employee and 5% employer contributions through Royal London (salary exchange scheme)
Healthshield Healthcare Cash Plan - optional benefit covering dental, optical and physiotherapy expenses, with children included at no additional cost and the option to add partners for a small monthly fee
24/7 Virtual GP service through Healthshield
Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
Employee discounts and rewards through Healthshield PERKS
Discounted gym memberships
Cycle to Work scheme
Annual professional membership fees reimbursed where applicable
Free on-site parking at the Doncaster office
Potential for up to 2 days hybrid working per week following an initial 3-month office-based period, subject to agreement
Flexible working hours

Role Overview:
My client is looking to appoint an experienced HR & Operations Coordinator to join their established HR team based in Doncaster.

This is a varied, hands-on coordination role, supporting the day-to-day running of the HR function within an established business operating across the infrastructure and energy sectors.

The team is looking for someone who can take ownership of administrative processes, improve efficiency and provide reliable support across a range of HR and business support activities.

This is not a traditional HR advisory position, and previous HR experience or CIPD qualifications are not essential. The hiring managers are particularly interested in candidates from strong administrative, office coordination, facilities coordination or compliance backgrounds who are confident managing multiple responsibilities and working independently.

The role will involve maintaining accurate employee records, coordinating recruitment and onboarding activities, supporting learning and development processes, preparing reports and ensuring documentation is organised and audit-ready.

A significant part of the position will involve working with Excel to manage data and produce weekly and monthly reports. The team currently operates several manual processes, so someone who is confident using Excel, including VLOOKUPs, and can identify opportunities to improve administrative efficiency would be particularly well suited.

You will be joining a small, supportive and experienced HR team where attention to detail, professionalism and a proactive approach are highly valued.

The business is ideally looking for someone who wants to establish themselves within a coordination role over the medium to long term, taking ownership of processes and becoming a dependable member of the team.

The position is primarily office-based in Doncaster, with the potential for up to two days of hybrid working once established in the role. This flexibility is discretionary rather than contractual.

Key Responsibilities:
Provide comprehensive administrative and coordination support to the HR team
Take ownership of day-to-day HR administration, ensuring processes are completed accurately and efficiently
Maintain employee personnel files, records and documentation, ensuring information is accurate, up to date and GDPR compliant
Support recruitment activities, including interview coordination, booking meeting rooms and arranging associated travel and logistics
Coordinate onboarding processes, including new starter documentation and employee records
Manage administrative activities within the company's learning and development platform, including setting up new starters and coordinating training requirements
Prepare weekly and monthly reports using Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, VLOOKUPs and maintaining spreadsheets
Support HR reporting, including maintaining and analysing employee data relating to absence, turnover and other key HR metrics
Identify opportunities to improve existing reporting and administrative processes
Maintain and update organisational charts and internal employee information
Ensure personnel records and compliance documentation are organised and ready for internal and external audits
Coordinate meetings, training events and other business activities, including booking venues, arranging catering and managing logistics
Support training administration, including raising purchase orders and maintaining training records
Assist with fleet administration and associated documentation where required
Liaise with payroll and other internal departments to ensure accurate employee information is maintained
Prepare meeting minutes and follow up on outstanding actions
Monitor outstanding administrative tasks and proactively follow up with colleagues to ensure deadlines are met
Communicate professionally with employees, managers and senior stakeholders across the business
Support the HR team with general administration, ad hoc projects and process improvements
Manage competing priorities independently while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail

Essential Requirements:
Minimum 2-3 years' experience within an administration, office coordination, business support or similar role
Experience within transport, infrastructure, engineering, energy or a similar operational environment
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including practical experience using VLOOKUPs and managing data
Experience producing reports, maintaining spreadsheets and working with administrative systems
Experience coordinating administrative processes and ensuring tasks are completed accurately and on time
Confident IT skills and the ability to learn new systems and platforms quickly

Desirable Requirements:
Previous experience working within an HR or people administration function
Background in office coordination, facilities coordination or compliance administration
Experience supporting recruitment, onboarding or employee documentation processes
Exposure to learning and development systems or training coordination
Experience preparing documentation for audits or working within a compliance-focused environment
Experience improving administrative processes or streamlining manual reporting activities
Experience supporting payroll administration, fleet administration or purchase order processes

Candidate Profile:
The hiring managers are particularly interested in a highly organised, dependable individual who enjoys taking ownership of administrative responsibilities and ensuring that day-to-day processes run smoothly.

You should be a proactive self-starter who can identify what needs doing, prioritise your workload and complete tasks without needing constant direction.

Strong attention to detail is essential, particularly when dealing with employee records, reporting, onboarding documentation and compliance requirements.

The team is looking for someone with a calm, professional and approachable personality who will work well within a close-knit office environment.

You should be comfortable communicating with stakeholders at all levels, including senior management, and confident following up on outstanding actions when required.

This opportunity would particularly suit an experienced Administrator, Office Coordinator, Facilities Coordinator or Business Support professional who enjoys a varied workload and is looking for a stable position with genuine responsibility.

Candidates do not need formal HR qualifications or previous HR experience, provided they can demonstrate strong administrative capability, excellent Excel skills and the ability to manage processes independently.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive HR team within an established business, taking ownership of a varied administrative workload and playing an important role in improving processes and supporting the wider organisation.

If you are interested in this opportunity, please send your CV to Brooke Stell at Carrington West or call (phone number removed) for a confidential discussion.

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant

Location: Doncaster

Salary: Competitive

Overview:

The HR Assistant will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to the HR team within a fast-paced food manufacturing environment. This role is key in ensuring HR processes run smoothly, supporting compliance with UK employment legislation, and maintaining accurate employee records.

Recruitment & Onboarding
- Assist with end-to-end recruitment processes (advertising roles, shortlisting, interview coordination).
- Prepare offer letters, contracts of employment, and onboarding documentation.
- Conduct right-to-work checks in accordance with UK Visas and Immigration guidelines.
- Coordinate induction programmes for new starters, including factory-based employees.

HR Administration
- Maintain and update employee records and HR systems in compliance with UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR).
- Process contractual changes, absence records, and employee correspondence.
- Support payroll preparation by collating and verifying employee data.
- Monitor and track probation periods and performance review deadlines.
- Conduct daily timesheet and hours checks for departments.
- Ensure any issues are reported in a timely manner to the Head of HR.
- Monitoring and responding to the HR inboxes providing prompt responses.
- Assist in the filing, scanning and administration of employee documentation.
- Maintain databases and training matrices / sign off matrices and chase for outstanding documentation.
- Administrate the Occupational Health clinics including the organising of appointments, liaising with the Nurse on the days and post admin actions in a timely manner.
- Ensuring new starters and leavers are maintained in a timely manner.

Employee Relations Support
- Provide administrative support for disciplinary, grievance, and absence management processes.
- Take minutes at HR meetings where required.
- Respond to general HR queries from employees and manager in a prompt manner.
- Report any issues to the Head of HR.

Compliance & Policy
- Support audits and inspections relevant to HR documentation.
- Help maintain training records, including food safety and health & safety certifications.

Learning & Development
- Coordinate training sessions and maintain training logs.
- Support the organisation of mandatory training such as food hygiene and workplace safety.

Person Specification

Essential
- Previous experience in an HR administrative role.
- Understanding of UK employment law principles.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
- Ability to handle sensitive information confidentially.

Desirable
- CIPD Level 3 qualification or working towards accreditation with the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development (CIPD).
- Experience within a manufacturing or food production environment.
- Familiarity with HRIS systems and payroll processes.

Join a Growing Commercial Property Team

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- Proficient IT skills and experience using case management systems.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary dependent on experience.
- Opportunity to work alongside experienced Commercial Property specialists.
- Ongoing training and career development.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Long-term career progression opportunities.

If you're looking to take the next step in your legal career and gain valuable experience within a thriving Commercial Property department, we'd love to hear from you.

To apply, please submit your CV today for a confidential discussion.

title: Part Time Payroll Administrator
description:
Part Time Payroll Administrator

£30k (FTE) Doncaster DN5

Permanent

If you are a detail-focused payroll administrator looking for 4 days per week (32 hours) Monday to Thursday) this might be the job for you! You will play an important role in a busy team, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time while maintaining compliance with payroll legislation and company policies. This is a great opportunity for someone with a professional payroll qualification such as Chartered Institute of Payroll Professionals (CIPP) or willingness to work towards one study support is available.

The payroll admin position is based in Doncaster and includes all the usual activities from process weekly hours and payroll data accurately within strict deadlines, inputting overtime, deductions, absence and adjustments to supporting statutory reporting and submissions to HMRC including FPS and EPS and acting as a first point of contact for payroll queries, resolving issues quickly.

To apply for the payroll admin position, you will need previous experience working within payroll processing, good understanding of payroll legislation and HMRC requirements and proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced skills such as VLOOKUP and Pivot Tables desirable).

As well as a full-time equivalent salary of £30k, the position of payroll admin includes:

Hours: (32 hours Monday to Thursday) usual office hours are 8.30am-5pm

Holidays: 25 days plus bank holidays (P/R)

Pension: The Company will make contributions of 7% of earnings into the scheme. In addition, for every 1% the employee contributes the Company will contribute a further 0.5% up to a maximum Company contribution of 10%

Extras: Employee assistance program, free parking, good access via bus and train

Environment: Very busy manufacturing / processing

Future: Expanding business, excellent opportunities

Travail Employment Group is acting as an employment agency in this instance.

title: Part-time Payroll Admin
description:
Portfolio Payroll are recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established and growing manufacturing business, who are looking to appoint an experienced Part-Time Payroll Administrator to join their friendly finance team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a payroll professional seeking flexibility whilst working within a supportive and stable environment.

The Role

Reporting into the Finance Manager, you will take ownership of the payroll function, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time. You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end payroll process using Sage Payroll and acting as a key point of contact for payroll-related queries.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing end-to-end payroll on a weekly and monthly basis
- Maintaining employee payroll records and ensuring data accuracy
- Processing starters, leavers, salary changes and statutory payments
- Managing SSP, SMP, SPP and other payroll-related calculations
- Submitting RTI reports to HMRC
- Processing pension contributions and handling auto-enrolment requirements
- Reconciling payroll reports and resolving payroll discrepancies
- Responding to employee payroll and pension queries
- Ensuring compliance with payroll legislation and company policies

About You
- Previous payroll experience within a standalone or payroll administration role
- Confident processing end-to-end payroll
- Experience using Sage Payroll is essential
- Strong understanding of HMRC legislation, RTI and statutory payments
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team

What's On Offer?
- Salary up to £30,000 FTE
- Flexible part-time hours
- Supportive and friendly working environment
- Stable and successful manufacturing business
- Opportunity to take ownership of the payroll function

title: Receptionist / Care Navigator
description: Would you like to help make a difference to patient care? Would you like to become part of our expanding practice? Would you consider yourself to be compassionate, an excellent communicator, with good keyboard skills? If so, we are currently recruiting and have vacancies for Receptionist/Care navigators. Patient Navigation: To assist patients in navigating the healthcare system by directing them to the appropriate services and resources, both within and outside the practice. Appointment Management : Schedule and manage patient appointments efficiently, ensuring optimal use of practice resources. Communication: Serve as the first point of contact for patients, providing a warm and welcoming environment both in person and over the phone. Administrative Support: Perform general administrative duties, including managing patient records, including registering new patients, and maintaining the reception area. Collaboration: Work closely with healthcare professionals within the practice to ensure a seamless patient journey. JOB SUMMARY The main purpose of the Receptionist/Care Navigator is to provide a point of contact for patients and to act as a focal point of communication between patients, doctors and other staff. Other duties include ensuring that the general administrative work of the Practice is undertaken efficiently and effectively. The reception desk is the first point of contact for patients when they contact the Practice either in person or by phone - and therefore it is very important that they are received with courtesy and politeness. Confidentiality is of prime importance and must be always maintained. Flexibility of working patterns is important in order to provide cover for colleagues during periods of annual leave or sickness. MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Receiving patients and other visitors at the reception desk. Navigating patients to the most appropriate service and documenting on appropriate template. Ensuring that patients' arrivals are logged correctly. Using the computer appointment system. Receiving telephone calls to the Practice, logging these and acting on them as appropriate. Explain practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary treatment, ensuring correct paperwork completed and passed to administrator for processing. Follow correct procedure for taking payments and issuing receipts. Action repeat prescription requests both electronically and manually and process accordingly Receiving and recording requests for home visits. Task management ensuring these are dealt with in a timely manner. Directing patients within the building as appropriate. Receiving and processing requests for repeat prescriptions. Making the working of the surgery as patient friendly as possible. Updating the waiting room white board(s) and notice board(s) as required.
